# Test the encrypted runtime dotenv loader lifecycle end-to-end.
# Verifies init, set, list, unlock (in-memory), unlock --materialize (0600),
# clean, doctor, and that plaintext never leaks into stdout/stderr/receipts/logs.
# Also verifies the strict parser rejects shell substitution on the read path,
# the wrong-key decrypt fails closed, and Git tracked-secret detection warns.

env PINAX_SYNC_FAKE_KEY=env-loader-e2e-key

# init vault
exec pinax init vault --title EnvLoader --json
stdout '"command":"vault.init"'

# init env asset — no plaintext file by default
exec pinax sync env init --vault vault --json
stdout '"command":"sync.env.init"'
stdout '"plaintext_created":"false"'
stdout '"schema_version":"pinax.sync.env.v1"'
! stdout 'PLAINTEXT'
# No plaintext .env created
! exists vault/.env

# set an env value — stdout must not contain the value
exec pinax sync env set COS_SECRET_KEY --value e2e-secret-value-AAAA --vault vault --json
stdout '"command":"sync.env.set"'
stdout '"key":"COS_SECRET_KEY"'
! stdout 'e2e-secret-value-AAAA'

# set a second value with equals in it (values may contain =)
exec pinax sync env set CONNECTION --value=host=db;port=5432 --vault vault --json
! stdout 'host=db;port=5432'

# list — key names only, no values
exec pinax sync env list --vault vault --json
stdout '"command":"sync.env.list"'
stdout '"key_count":"2"'
! stdout 'e2e-secret-value-AAAA'
! stdout 'host=db'

# unlock in memory — no materialize, no value leak
exec pinax sync env unlock --vault vault --json
stdout '"command":"sync.env.unlock"'
stdout '"materialized":"false"'
! stdout 'e2e-secret-value-AAAA'
# No materialized file
! exists vault/.pinax/runtime/pinax-sync.env

# unlock --materialize writes 0600 file
exec pinax sync env unlock --vault vault --materialize --json
stdout '"materialized":"true"'
stdout '"permissions":"0600"'
! stdout 'e2e-secret-value-AAAA'
exists vault/.pinax/runtime/pinax-sync.env

# materialized file must be 0600 and exist; verify permissions via stat
exec sh -c 'test "$(stat -c %a vault/.pinax/runtime/pinax-sync.env)" = "600"'

# clean removes only the managed file
exec pinax sync env clean --vault vault --json
stdout '"removed":"true"'
! exists vault/.pinax/runtime/pinax-sync.env

# doctor — healthy, no value leak
exec pinax sync env doctor --vault vault --json
stdout '"command":"sync.env.doctor"'
stdout '"code":"healthy"'
! stdout 'e2e-secret-value-AAAA'

# encrypted asset must be present and committable; plaintext must NOT exist
exists vault/.pinax/pinax-sync.env.age
! exists vault/.env

# .gitignore must protect plaintext env and re-include the encrypted asset
exec sh -c 'grep -q "^\.env$" vault/.gitignore'
exec sh -c 'grep -q "^\*\.env$" vault/.gitignore'
exec sh -c 'grep -q "^\.pinax/runtime/" vault/.gitignore'
exec sh -c 'grep -q "^!\.pinax/pinax-sync.env.age$" vault/.gitignore'
exec sh -c 'grep -q "^!\.env.example$" vault/.gitignore'

# wrong-key decrypt must fail closed: change the fake key, then unlock fails
env PINAX_SYNC_FAKE_KEY=wrong-key-different
! exec pinax sync env unlock --vault vault --json

# restore the correct key for subsequent assertions
env PINAX_SYNC_FAKE_KEY=env-loader-e2e-key
